blocks.x: I’m Bob Daughtry. It’s Tuesday, May 5th, 2004. We’re in Jamaica Plain, Massachusetts. This is for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Project, Katea Stitt is engineering. We’re here with Mr. George Russell, and this is tape 2 continued. George, how are you today?
